<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ITSolutionRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request and deployment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ITSolutionRequest">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Requester" name="Employee or department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Request</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCompatibility</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateCostsResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcureToolsLicenses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InstallSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestControlledEnvironment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RollOut</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Training</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideTraining</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TrainingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MakeSupportAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SupportAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_TestUnsuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Request" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit request for an IT solution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCompatibility" name="Check compatibility with existing systems"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateCostsResources" name="Evaluate cost and resource needs"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_Approval_No"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcureToolsLicenses" name="Procure necessary tools or licenses"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstallSolution" name="Install solution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestControlledEnvironment" name="Test solution in a controlled environment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Testing successful?" default="Flow_Test_No"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RollOut" name="Roll out solution to requesting department"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training" name="Provide training?" default="Flow_Training_No"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingMerge" name="Merge training paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeSupportAvailable" name="Make IT support available for troubleshooting"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SupportAvailable" name="IT support available"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Request not approved"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TestUnsuccessful" name="Testing unsuccessful"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Submit" sourceRef="StartEvent_Request" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_CheckCompatibility" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCompatibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckCompatibility_Evaluate" sourceRef="Task_CheckCompatibility" targetRef="Task_EvaluateCostsResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evaluate_Approval" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateCostsResources" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_ProcureToolsLicenses">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_No" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procure_Install" sourceRef="Task_ProcureToolsLicenses" targetRef="Task_InstallSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Install_Test" sourceRef="Task_InstallSolution" targetRef="Task_TestControlledEnvironment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Result" sourceRef="Task_TestControlledEnvironment" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RollOut">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">testingSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_No" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="EndEvent_TestUnsuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RollOut_Training" sourceRef="Task_RollOut" targetRef="Gateway_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">trainingProvided</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_No" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Done" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingMerge_Support" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge" targetRef="Task_MakeSupportAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Support_End" sourceRef="Task_MakeSupportAvailable" targetRef="EndEvent_SupportAvailable"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ITSolutionRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request process" processRef="Process_ITSolutionRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
